title: MiniCircle Production
author: Eric Danner
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7kwhkxe

steps.title: Clone Plasmid into DH5alpha E-coli
steps.instruction: Perform cloning using normal DH5alpha E-coli (or equivalent) under Kanamycin (Kan) conditions.

substeps.instruction: Use LB/Kan media.
Allow 30-60 min shaking for resistance after heat-shock due to Kan toxicity.

steps.title: Transform ZYCY10P3S2T Cells
steps.instruction: Re-transform 1-20ng of the correct plasmid into ZYCY10P3S2T cells.

substeps.instruction: Prepare cells as per standard chemically competent E.Coli strain protocols.
Optionally grow cells in TB media overnight and freeze in a 50% glycerol stock.

steps.title: Prepare Terrific Broth (TB) Media
steps.instruction: Prepare TB media and 10x phosphate buffer, then mix and supplement with Kanamycin.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 900ml TB: 12g tryptone, 24g yeast, 4ml glycerol.
Prepare 1L 10x phosphate buffer: 23.12g KH2PO4, 125.41g K2HPO4.
Autoclave both bottles and mix in a 9:1 ratio.
Add Kanamycin to a final concentration of 25-50ug/ml.

steps.title: Inoculate and Grow Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate bacteria and grow to the required density.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate a bacteria/glycerol stab or picked colony in 2ml TB for 2 hours at 37°C and 250 rpm.
Add 100ul of this culture to 200ml of pre-warmed TB with Kan.
Shake at 220-250 rpm for 16 hours (monitor earlier to prevent overgrowth).

steps.title: Verify OD600 and pH
steps.instruction: Measure the OD600 of the culture to ensure it is within the optimal range for minicircle production.

substeps.instruction: Perform a 1:10 dilution with TB; multiply the resulting reading (expected 0.4-0.6) by 10 to get the original OD600.
Ensure OD600 is between 4-6 to minimize gDNA contamination.
Discard cells and restart if OD600 > 8.5 or if pH < 6.5.

steps.title: Prepare Induction Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare the induction medium and adjust the pH of the culture mixture.

substeps.instruction: Mix 200ml LB with 200μl 20% arabinose (no kanamycin needed).
Mix 200ml of this induction media with 200ml of the culture.
Titrate the pH to 7-7.3 using 1N NaOH.

steps.title: Induce Minicircle Production
steps.instruction: Induce the recombinase and nuclease using arabinose.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the mixture (400ml total) at 32°C and 250 rpm for 3-5 hours.
Optional: Monitor recombination every hour by taking a 1-2ml mini-prep, linearizing with a restriction enzyme, and running on a gel (lower band indicates recombined minicircle).

steps.title: Harvest and Maxiprep DNA
steps.instruction: Pellet the cells and extract the DNA using a Maxiprep kit.

substeps.instruction: Pellet the culture at 4°C (store pellet at -20°C if necessary).
Use the MN Xtra Kit; for OD600 = 6, you can pellet up to 400ml of cells (pre-induction volume).
Add sufficient lysis buffer as per the kit formula to ensure full lysis of all bacteria.
Elute in 150ul TB.

steps.title: Analyze Purified Minicircles
steps.instruction: Run an undigested aliquot of the purified MC on a gel to assess gDNA and original plasmid contamination.

substeps.instruction: Run an undigested aliquot.
Optionally run an aliquot digested at one spot.

steps.title: Digest Plasmid Backbone and gDNA
steps.instruction: Use restriction enzymes to linearize the non-recombined plasmid and gDNA.

substeps.instruction: Select two restriction sites present in the backbone but not in the minicircle.
Prepare a 200μl reaction: 20μl buffer, 5μl Restriction enzyme 1, 5μl Restriction enzyme 2, total eluted maxiprep, and H2O to reach 200μl.
Incubate on a shaker for 1-2 hours at 37°C.

steps.title: Digest Linear DNA with Plasmid-safe DNase
steps.instruction: Remove linearized gDNA and plasmid while preserving the circular minicircle.

substeps.instruction: Prepare reaction: 200μl from the previous digestion + 25μl 10x DNase buffer + 10μl ATP + 5μl H2O + 10μl DNase.
Incubate on a shaker at 37°C overnight (16-20 hours).

steps.title: Final Purification
steps.instruction: Halt the enzyme reaction and purify the minicircles.

substeps.instruction: Halt enzyme activity by heating at 70°C for 30 minutes.
Use a PCR/gel cleanup mini kit (each column binds 25g; use multiple columns in series if necessary).
Warm the column to 70°C and elute in 20ul TE or water.
Verify concentration with Nanodrop and analyze via gel electrophoresis.
